narrative: On the almanack. The penny almanac open on a knee in the parish church. The date is printed. No pen is in the frame, and no face. On the almanack. The same page. The margin beside the date is blank. The book is not marked.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Sat the hour and did not mark the day.

entities.name: the penny almanac
entities.context: Shown on almanac in The almanac on the knee
